overview.description: The REX Defensive Autocallable Income ETF (DACL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. The fund is passively managed, seeking to provide monthly income of 3% above SOFR through a daily leveraged synthetic laddered autocallable portfolio. The ETF aims to provide a 50% downside buffer, using 200% daily leveraged exposure. DACL was launched on Aug 12, 2026 and is issued by REX Shares.
